Burn = cost multiple vs GPT-6 Luna (same base in both tables).

## Codex (OpenAI credits per 1M tokens)

+----------------+------------------+--------------+----------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+
| Model          | `codex -m`       | Input / 1M   | Cached input / | Output / 1M  | Input burn | Cached     | Output     |
|                |                  |              | 1M             |              |            | burn       | burn       |
+================+==================+==============+================+==============+============+============+============+
| GPT-6 Luna     | `gpt-6-luna`     | 2.5          | 0.25           | 12.5         | 1×         | 1×         | 1×         |
+----------------+------------------+--------------+----------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+
| GPT-6 Sol      | `gpt-6-sol`      | 50           | 5              | 250          | 20×        | 20×        | 20×        |
+----------------+------------------+--------------+----------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+
| GPT-6.1 Sol    | `gpt-6.1-sol`    | 50           | 2.5            | 250          | 20×        | 10×        | 20×        |
+----------------+------------------+--------------+----------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+
| GPT-6 Astra    | `gpt-6-astra`    | 250          | 25             | 1,250        | 100×       | 100×       | 100×       |
+----------------+------------------+--------------+----------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+

- Credits = 25 × the OpenAI API USD rate; Codex does not charge for cache writes.
- Fast mode: 2× the standard rate. GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra/Sol remain available during the GPT-6 rollout.
- API long context (>272K input): 2× input and cached, 1.5× output.

## Claude Code (Anthropic API USD per 1M tokens)

+----------------+------------------+------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+
| Model          | `/model`         | Input / 1M | Cache write  | Cache hit  | Output /   | Input burn | Cached     | Output     |
|                |                  |            | (5m) / 1M    | / 1M       | 1M         |            | burn       | burn       |
+================+==================+============+==============+============+============+============+============+============+
| Haiku 5.5      | `haiku`          | $0.10      | $0.125       | $0.01      | $0.50      | 1×         | 1×         | 1×         |
+----------------+------------------+------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+
| Sonnet 5.5     | `sonnet`         | $2         | $2.50        | $0.10      | $10        | 20×        | 10×        | 20×        |
+----------------+------------------+------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+
| Opus 5.5       | `opus` (default) | $4         | $5           | $0.20      | $20        | 40×        | 20×        | 40×        |
+----------------+------------------+------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+
| Opus 5.5 fast  | `opus` + `/fast` | $8         | $10          | $0.40      | $40        | 80×        | 40×        | 80×        |
+----------------+------------------+------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+
| Fable 5.1      | `fable`          | $10        | $12.50       | $0.25      | $50        | 100×       | 25×        | 100×       |
+----------------+------------------+------------+--------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+

- Pro/Max/Team plans draw from plan usage limits instead; API-key sessions bill these rates.
- Haiku 5.5 prompts >100K tokens: 5× all rates. 1h cache writes: 2× input.
- `opusplan`: Opus in plan mode, Sonnet for execution.
